Turkey Burger
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, February 14, 2010 - 5:31am

Ingredients




2 pounds minced skinless raw turkey thigh meat
3 tablespoons minced parsley
2 tablespoons dry bread crumbs
1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme
1 tablespoon Poultry Dry Rub (see 1 tablespoon minced onions

Preparation

1 In a large mixing bowl combine turkey meat with first 6 ingredients. Mix thoroughly and chill in refrigerator for at least 2 hours. 2 When ready to grill, form into large patties and grill for 5 minuets on each side or until done. Make sure turkey mixture is cold before grilling. 3 Serve with your choice of condiments. 4 This recipe yields 6 servings.
